summary: A docs folder whose remote moved on without it
description: The situation push/pull exists for, and the only one a rejection can be tested in: two commits were pushed by somebody else and one was made here and never published. Nothing has fetched yet, so the app starts out not knowing it is behind — which is what gives Fetch something to discover and Push something to be refused for. The two sides write different files on purpose, so the pull that mends it merges cleanly.
